claim.claim-text: 1. A method, comprising:

2. The method of claim 1, wherein to request modification of the one or more QoS flow descriptions for the PDU session, the method further comprises: providing a PDU session modification request message to the cellular network entity of the 5GC network, wherein the PDU session modification request comprises a mapped evolved packet service (EPS) bearer contexts information element and requests one or more modifications to the quality of service (QoS) of one or more mapped EPS bearer contexts of the PDU session.

3. The method of claim 2, further comprising: receiving a PDU session modification reject message in response to the PDU session modification request message, wherein the PDU session modification reject message includes a cause code for invalid mapped EPS bearer QoS.
4. The method of claim 1, further comprising:

providing a service request to the 5GC network, wherein the service request is for a service that is not supported by the 5GC network; and receiving a PDU session release message indicating to release the PDU session, wherein the PDU session release message includes a cause code indicating to fallback to evolved packet service (EPS).
5. The method of claim 4, wherein the PDU session release message further includes a mapped EPS bearer contexts information element indicating EPS bearer mapping information for the PDU session.
6. The method of claim 1, further comprising:

determining that the PDU session may flow at least in part between the wireless device and a long term evolution (LTE) enhanced node-B (eNB), wherein modification of the one or more QoS flow descriptions for the PDU session is requested based at least in part on determining that the PDU session may flow at least in part between the wireless device and the LTE eNB.
7. The method of claim 1, further comprising:

determining that inter-RAT mobility to an evolved packet core (EPC) network is triggered, wherein modification of the one or more QoS flow descriptions for the PDU session is requested based at least in part on determining that inter-RAT mobility to an EPC network is triggered.
8. A method, comprising:
9. The method of claim 8, further comprising:

receiving a PDU session modification request message from the wireless device, wherein the PDU session modification request comprises a mapped EPS bearer contexts information element to request one or more modifications to a QoS of one or more mapped EPS bearer contexts of the PDU session, wherein the one or more QoS flow descriptions for the PDU session with the wireless device are modified based at least in part on the PDU session modification request message.
10. The method of claim 8, further comprising:

receiving a PDU session modification request message from the wireless device, wherein the PDU session modification request comprises a mapped EPS bearer contexts information element to request one or more modifications to a QoS of one or more mapped EPS bearer contexts of the PDU session; and providing a PDU session modification reject message to the wireless device in response to the PDU session modification request message, wherein the PDU session modification reject message includes a cause code for invalid mapped EPS bearer QoS.

11. The method of claim 8, wherein the method is performed by a cellular network element comprising a fifth generation core (5GC) network session management function (SMF) entity, and wherein the method further comprises:

receiving a service request from the wireless device, wherein the service request is for a service that is not supported by the 5GC network; and providing a PDU session release message to release the PDU session with the wireless device based at least in part on the service request being for a service that is not supported by the 5GC network, wherein the PDU session release message includes a cause code indicating to fallback to evolved packet service (EPS).

12. The method of claim 11, wherein the PDU session release message further includes a mapped EPS bearer contexts information element indicating EPS bearer mapping information for the PDU session with the wireless device.
13. An apparatus, comprising: at least one processor configured to cause a wireless device to perform the method of any of claims 1-7.
14. The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising: a radio operably coupled to the at least one processor.
15. An apparatus, comprising: at least one processor configured to cause a cellular network element to perform the method of any of claims 8-12.
